dom.title: ILUZTAR - Motion Graphic
dom.description: Company profile digital ILUZTAR Studio berbasis motion graphic interaktif. Dibuat oleh artist ILUZTAR untuk skripsi “Pengembangan Company Profile Digital Studio Kreatif ILUZTAR dengan Menggunakan Motion Graphic sebagai Media Promosi”, dikonversi dari video motion menjadi website dengan bantuan Claude AI (Opus 5.5).

scenes.label: Scene 1: Intro
scenes.teks: This is Iluztar, a creative studio based in Bandar Lampung, Indonesia, built by artists, for artists, since 2023.

scenes.label: Scene 2: The problem
scenes.teks: Got a project that's growing faster than you can handle? Tight deadlines, unfinished sketches, and too many things on your plate?

scenes.label: Scene 4: Services
scenes.teks: Whether it's a full commission or just an extra pair of hands (sketch, lineart, or base color), we've got you covered.

scenes.label: Scene 5: Same care
scenes.teks: Big project or a single task, we treat every piece with the same care, precision, and attention to detail.

scenes.label: Scene 6: You and we
scenes.teks: You keep the vision, we handle the workload. You create, we refine. You dream, we help you build it.

scenes.label: Scene 7: Ownership
scenes.teks: And every piece stays true to your style, your direction, and most importantly, your ownership.

scenes.label: Scene 8: Call to action
scenes.teks: Ready to bring your next project to life? Find us on Instagram at iluztar, or visit iluztar.com.
